text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This very evening, a terrifying monster will descend upon you…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: OoOoOh, And now, to curse yoOuUu toOoOo!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: …Aaaand cut! That rehearsal was perfect! Boy, am I glad I asked you to play this part!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much! I'll do my best to help promote the park's "Heart-Pounding ☆ Horror Night" event.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today, the amusement park is shooting an event commercial, and Super Creek is playing one of the monsters that attack the park guests…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: …So how come me and your trainer gotta be extras? We just came to watch.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Eh, I guess this is Creek's big break. Sure, I'll do what I can!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Thank you both very much. Let's all work together to make this the best commercial it can be! ♪

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: Right, next is the scene where the extras make a frantic escape! And four… three… two… Action!

text_block_list.name: Werewolf
text_block_list.text: Grrraaawwwr!

text_block_list.name: Zombies
text_block_list.text: Grughhhnnnn… Ughhh…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: …Now, join me… in eternal slumbeeer!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Eep! I can't believe they're not real! I'm gettin' da heebie-jeebies!

text_block_list.name: Zombies
text_block_list.text: Nghhhh… Uwaghhhh…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: WAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh dear! Is Tamtam all right?

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: Next up we've got the forest scene! This is where the wolfman takes a great big bite out of our academy trainer!

text_block_list.name: Werewolf
text_block_list.text: Grrrawwrrrr! Gahhh!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I… I…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I can't take this any longer! Mr. Werewolf, please, leave them alone!

text_block_list.name: Werewolf
text_block_list.text: Grrr… Rawr?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: What're ya doin'?! You're supposed to be a crazy mummy!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh no, you've got it wrong. I'm a mommy, not a mummy! Were you afraid? Are you hurt? I can wrap you right up with one of my bandages. ♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wha?! I'm not scared, I'm actin'! Plus, it's not like I've been bitten or anythin' either!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Don't you fret. Just leave it to Mommy! I've got a bundle of cuddles with your name written all over it. ♪

text_block_list.name: Werewolf
text_block_list.text: G-grrrr… Grawwwr!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: …Oh dear. Well, if you're not going to behave, then I'll have to cast a "good boy" curse on you!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: …Cut! Cut, cut, cuuuut!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: …Oh? Ah! I'm so sorry! I completely forgot we were filming and—

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: That… was… INCREDIBLE!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huh? How come? Wasn't Creek way outta line with her improv?!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: Absolutely not! This'll be an emotion-packed masterpiece about a mummy who awakens to her maternal instincts! What an astonishing performance! This commercial's gonna go viral for sure!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, will it? I just couldn't bear to leave the two of them so helpless…

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: It's precisely your realism that made it so effective! You think so too, don't you, Trainer?
choice_data_list: You wouldn't get a performance like that from anyone else!
I'm not sure this'll work as an ad for the event…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Is that so? Well, I'm relieved to hear it.

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: Yeah, let's keep up this momentum! Okay, we're gonna pick up from when our mummy awakens to her maternal instincts!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: So, um… should I go like this?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Tamtam, you're such a good girl. There, there…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: You're not even actin' anymore! You're scarier than the actual monsters!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The commercial, which ends up being a showcase of motherly love, goes viral a few days later. I hear the event itself turns out to be a massive success from day one!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah, you're totally right! I'm sorry for going off and doing my own thing.

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: True, I do want to capture a normal take, actually! …Let's go from the scene with the wolfman attack!

text_block_list.name: Werewolf
text_block_list.text: Grrrahhh!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: AAAH! SOMEONE HELP ME!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I-I just can't! Pleeease don't hurt them!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Countless retakes later, the cast and crew eventually manage to wrap up the shoot!
